source.title: Open Problems and Conjectures: On third-order rational difference equations with quadratic terms

trace.notes: Normalized the single input as the zbMATH resolver URL https://zbmath.org/5309220 with source name 5309220. Local resolver metadata in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv identified DOI 10.1080/10236190802054118 and year 2008; this metadata was used only for identity and recovery, not as extraction evidence.

Failure mode: paywalled_or_restricted / metadata_only. Shell fetches to zbmath.org, api.zbmath.org, and related network endpoints failed with network_or_dns_failure in the local sandbox. Web recovery by exact DOI, exact title, and author-title found the Taylor & Francis DOI landing page for Journal of Difference Equations and Applications 14(8), pages 889-897, but not a readable full-text PDF or HTML artifact.

Rejected recovered candidates because they were not readable primary sources for the same work: the Taylor & Francis table of contents and DOI page exposed only metadata/preview/access links; Springer, De Gruyter, Dergipark, and other pages were later related works citing or solving selected Sedaghat problems; the author CV listed the publication but did not contain the article text.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. No questions were extracted because the available sources were resolver metadata, snippets, landing pages, or different works.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/5309220.json and outputs/latest.json.
